title: Exact Unlearning After Data Curation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training pipelines often remove similar examples before fitting a model. Deleting a raw record can change that selection and admit an example that was excluded before. What must a service retain to reproduce training after such requests? We answer this question for a fixed rule in which earlier similar records block later ones. A limit on the total number of future deletions identifies exactly which records can still enter training. We use this boundary to build a summary of training statistics that can be repaired exactly after repeated deletions. The repaired summary is the same as rebuilding it on the surviving data with the remaining budget. We also construct finite-precision features for ridge regression, a linear learner with a penalty on coefficient size. With exact rational outputs, allowing one more deletion changes the required private information. It rises from zero to every private feature sign in the excluded candidates. A

translated_title: 数据筛选后的精确遗忘
translated_abstract: 训练流程通常在拟合模型之前移除相似的样本。删除一条原始记录可能会改变这一筛选结果，使之前被排除的样本得以进入训练。面对这样的删除请求，服务需要保留哪些信息才能重现训练过程？我们针对一个固定规则回答了这一问题：在该规则下，较早出现的相似记录会阻止较晚出现的记录。对未来删除总数的限制恰好确定了哪些记录仍能进入训练。我们利用这一边界构建了一个训练统计量摘要，该摘要在多次删除后可以被精确修复，且修复后的摘要与在剩余预算下基于存活数据重新构建的结果完全一致。我们还为岭回归——一种对系数大小施加惩罚的线性学习器——构建了有限精度特征。在精确有理数输出的情况下，允许再多一次删除会改变所需的私有信息：其需求从零上升到被排除候选样本中所有私有特征的符号。
tldr: 该论文针对数据筛选（相似样本去重）场景提出了精确机器遗忘方案：利用未来删除总数上限确定训练准入边界，构建可在多次删除后精确修复且与重新训练结果完全一致的训练统计摘要，并揭示在岭回归中允许的删除次数每增加一次，所需保留的私有信息就会从零增长到被排除候选的全部特征符号。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an exact unlearning framework for data curation pipelines: a deletion-budget boundary determines which records can still enter training, enabling a summary of training statistics that can be repaired exactly to match retraining on surviving data, and shows that for ridge regression each additional allowed deletion raises the required private information from zero to all feature signs of excluded candidates.
